mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and industrial production indicates broad economic expansion that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime with federal funds rate above 4.5%, higher borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 2000 thousand units signals residential sector contraction that reduces economic activity and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation and high unemployment signal stagflation that erodes corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 115 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 115, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
